observations: Photo 0 shows a tablet with a keyboard attached, displaying the Windows 11 default wallpaper. The screen has visible cracks on the top left and right corners. The keyboard is dusty and has a watermark 'DEETECH GADGETZ'.
Photo 1 shows the back of the device, which is dark gray with a Windows logo sticker in the center. The surface is scratched and scuffed. A hand is holding the device, showing its size and condition.
No model number or branding is visible on the device in either photo. The seller claims it is a Microsoft Surface Pro 7, but no text on the device confirms this.
The screen is on and appears to be functional, showing the desktop with icons and taskbar.
The keyboard is attached magnetically and appears to be a Type Cover, typical for Surface devices.
